meta.title: Norwegian traffic signs — English catalogue
meta.description: English-primary catalogue of Norwegian warning signs (fareskilt) and speed-limit-related signs. Names and meanings are in English; official Norwegian NVDB wording is retained in name_nb.

gaps.explanation: Codes present in NVDB but without a resolvable graphic in Geonorge or vegvesen EPS/JPG packs. Kept in the database with svg=null.

schema.name: English sign name
schema.meaning: Plain-English explanation of what the sign means
schema.svg: Relative SVG path, or null if unresolved
